0022600144.text: The Hawks (2-2) host the Cavaliers (2-1) in Atlanta's sixth game of the season, with the Hawks losing their last two and sitting 2nd in the Southeast, one game back, and 7th in the East. Atlanta is 0-1 at home and 2-1 on the road, while Cleveland is 2-0 at home, 0-1 on the road, winning two straight, and 2nd in the Central, half a game back. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Hawks winning the last meeting 124-102 in Atlanta on April 10, 2026; they have not yet met this season.
